scope.countingRule: Only the 25 canonical top-level rows count as outstanding. Subtasks, manual groups, blockers, receipts and regression baselines are not additional top-level rows.

requiredForAcceptance: one owned runtime or an explicitly approved external test environment
real user actions or authenticated HTTP requests
persistent read-back in a fresh session where applicable
console, pageerror, requestfailed and business HTTP error accounting
no-side-effect snapshot after denied or failed operations
cleanup receipt for all owned data and runtime resources
notAcceptance: empty-array HTTP 200 without a dataset contract
SQL repair/reset of the acceptance dataset

executionClasses.auto: Can proceed with repository tests, private fixtures or an owned runtime without user-provided credentials or a production change window.
executionClasses.external-input-required: Implementation can proceed, but final acceptance waits for named credentials, accounts, broker or partner environment; secrets remain private.
executionClasses.production-window-required: Final acceptance requires an approved backup, maintenance/change window and rollback authority; never apply to shared services automatically.

activeAssignments.scope: Current-source backend package/images and one owned HTTP/UI acceptance stack.

Executable ledger and exact owned Unicode metadata collection/migration proposal; no DDL.

Real MySQL/BI consumer calculation and chart display use total planned cases, not executed cases, as the test pass-rate denominator.

Topic/discussion organization/team/private visibility, replies/comments/reactions, close/reopen/move/trash/restore/archive; attachments and replies follow owning scope.
Independent real DingTalk and WeCom configuration, manual PLM user creation, phone match/explicit binding, sync/message/workbench, wrong-identity/cross-org denial and revocation.

phases.name: Source and evidence preparation
phases.exit: Inputs, roles, routes and acceptance contracts are version-bound.

phases.name: Owned runtime permissions and native UI
phases.exit: Owned HTTP/UI positive and negative evidence is complete with cleanup.

phases.name: Business lifecycle and localization
phases.exit: Real multi-role bilingual workflows and read-back are accepted.

phases.name: External and offline closure
phases.exit: External credentials/broker or explicit capability decisions are recorded; offline recovery is verified.

phases.name: Clean reconstruction and release
phases.exit: Source/runtime closure and approved rollout/rollback are evidenced.

schedulingRules: Phases are priority waves, not permission to ignore the item DAG. A phase may wait on an earlier gate or a later-listed shared prerequisite.

Dependencies order execution gates, not source exploration. Agents may implement independently, but may accept a subtask only after its dependencies have the required evidence; source/unit tests do not satisfy a real-runtime gate.
Only one owned runtime is active at a time; exact receipt identity, network, image and mount checks are mandatory before cleanup.
External-input and production-window items remain blocked until the named inputs/approval exist; do not invent credentials or infer approval.
F01-F05 are regression baselines and must be rerun after changes but never counted as closure of the 25 outstanding items.
A failed or interrupted run remains failed/blocked with its raw private evidence; it is not converted to pass by filtering errors or reusing an old receipt.
